baseline_required: First exact LIVE anchor; all governed PL/rho <=1e-10 and energy/SUMEC/SUMEV <=1e-8 Ry.

case_rules.opposite_spin: use opposite spin Vin with own independent q2 formula; predicted raw-minus-wrong is t_wrong+r_fit(t_wrong/q0).
case_rules.scalar_plus_001: Apply V=vI to captured starting spectral moments: c_prime=c-0.01 Ry and q2_prime=q2_RAW exactly. Predicted raw-minus-shifted SUMEV per spin is 0.01*q0+r_fit(0.01); compare residual-only error to A_scalar.
case_rules.sign: wrong center c+t/q0; hold correct local q2; predicted raw-minus-wrong is -t+r_fit(-t/q0).

excluded_attempts.attempt: Initial five-case invocation before persistent-output fix
excluded_attempts.note: The production driver completed, but report serialization failed because the output directory did not exist; TemporaryDirectory removed the raw driver output. The attempt also used an unexecuted scalar q2_LOCAL draft contrary to the locked RAW-q2 identity. No numeric case values were retained or inspected. The frozen five-case batch is rerun with captured RAW q2, persistent input/output files, unchanged physical predictions and allowances.

locked_fit_policy: Use RS own fourteen-point cubic/loglog scan for A2.2 residuals; use original eight signed A1 shifts only for A2.1 intercept. D0_RS is used once; u_RS remains separate.
null_rule: Compare signed Tr(V_wrong P)-Tr(V_true P) to A_true+A_wrong+E_num; operator null diagnostics P-P^T and ImP are measured without an invented energy cutoff.

scalar_gate.residual_inclusive_prediction: Delta_SUMEV = sum(0.01*q0_s + r_fit_s(0.01)); supplementary diagnostic only, not the gate comparator.
